verdict.rationale: A probe confirms an official Stripe MCP server documented at docs.stripe.com/mcp, so an agent can connect through a first-party server. The evidence only establishes that the server exists, with no detail on its tools or setup. Missing for 10: documentation of which Connect operations (connected accounts, payouts, transfers) the MCP server exposes, authentication and setup details, and independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.
